_doc: Reference-plate manifest for Birch (Betula nigra). Stage-0 source list; binaries download in Stage-1 ingest (downloaded:false). Jacob ratifies identification (ratified:false).
identityNotes: JUDGMENT CALL (reference research): River Birch — the standard heat-and-borer-tolerant urban-park birch for St. Louis / zone 6b (paper/white birches struggle here). Missouri native. Typically MULTI-STEMMED; the salmon-to-cinnamon peeling papery bark is its single most diagnostic feature (NOT the chalky white of paper birch).

plates.caption: Multi-stem habit with fine open canopy; diamond-shaped doubly-toothed leaves (leaf detail: File:River_Birch_Betula_nigra_Leaf_2500px.jpg).
Yellow autumn foliage on the airy crown.

plates.credit: Wikimedia Commons — 'River Birch Betula nigra Bark Vertical.JPG'
plates.caption: Signature salmon/cinnamon exfoliating papery curling bark — the defining ID trait.
